name: Sampler
author: E. T. Carter
description: A cross-stitch sampler: an all-over lattice of little X marks bowed by a slow woven distortion, the stitches lengthening and brightening as radial waves pass through them.

params.label: Stitch spacing
params.effect: Distance between stitches in CSS px - a dense tight sampler at the minimum, an open sparse lattice at the maximum.

params.label: Arm length
params.effect: Resting length of the X arms. Short keeps tidy little crosses; long throws bold stitched X-bars that nearly touch.

params.label: Arm thickness
params.effect: Thickness of the stitch arms. Fine draws hairline crosses; thick fattens them into bold blocky X marks.

params.label: Stretch
params.effect: How much a passing wavefront lengthens each stitch. 0 is a still lattice; high stretches the arms along the wave.

params.label: Wavelength
params.effect: Spacing of the concentric wave rings; short packs many stretch bands across the frame, long sweeps one broad wave.

params.label: Wave speed
params.effect: Speed the wave travels out from the source; 0 freezes the lattice mid-stretch.

params.label: Ripple count
params.effect: How many concentric wave rings span the field. Low is one broad slow sweep; high packs many tight stretch bands.

params.label: Stitch brightness
params.effect: Brightness of the stitches themselves. Low keeps them subtle, high makes the lattice pop in vivid colour.

params.label: Backlight
params.effect: Strength of the two soft drifting glow blobs behind the lattice. 0 leaves crisp stitches on near-black; high adds a slow colour drift.

params.label: Crispness
params.effect: Edge hardness of the stitches. Low is soft glowing X marks; high snaps them to crisp high-contrast crosses.

params.label: Weave
params.effect: Sine-warps the lattice so the rows bow and ripple like hand-stitched cloth. 0 is a perfect grid; high gives a loose woven sag.

params.label: Origin X
params.effect: Horizontal position of the point the waves radiate from. 0 is centre; +/- drives the source off toward an edge.

params.label: Origin Y
params.effect: Vertical position of the wave source. 0 is centre; +/- pushes it up or down.

params.label: Rotation
params.effect: Spins the whole lattice off the upright axis so the rows of stitches run diagonally.
